# Check: cell becomes 2 if it's a background neighbor of two or more distinct 4-runs (not aligned)?
def f(inp):
    import copy
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    dirs=[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=inp[r][c]
            nb=dirs
            cnt={}
            for dr,dc in dirs:
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and inp[rr][cc]==v: cnt[(rr,cc)]=cnt.get((rr,cc),0)+1
            # run length along each dir: count consecutive same-value runs through this cell
            runs=[]
            for dr,dc in dirs:
                n=1
                while True:
                    rr,cc=r+dr, c+dc
                    if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and inp[rr][cc]==v: n+=1; rr,cc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                    else: break
                runs.append(n)
            if v==8 and max(runs)>1:
                out[r][c]=2
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]; out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bg: continue
            v0 = r==0; v1 = r==h-1; h0 = c==0; h1 = c==w-1
            def wall(dy,dx):
                y,x=r+dy,c+dx
                return not(-1<y<h and -1<x<w) or g[y][x]!=bg
            up=wall(-1,0); dn=wall(1,0); lf=wall(0,-1); rt=wall(0,1)
            if (up and dn) or (lf and rt): out[r][c]=2
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def solve(g, tmax=5, axis='both'):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]; out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bg: continue
            ls=[x for x in range(c) if g[r][x]!=bg]; rs=[x for x in range(c+1,w) if g[r][x]!=bg]
            ss=[y for y in range(r) if g[y][c]!=bg]; ds=[y for y in range(r+1,h) if g[y][c]!=bg]
            L=max(ls,default=None); R=min(rs,default=None)
            U=max(ss,default=None); D=min(ds,default=None)
            bh=(L is not None and R is not None); vb=(U is not None and D is not None)
            pred=False
            if bh:
                gh=(c-L)+(R-c)
                pred |= gh<=tmax
            if vb:
                gv=(r-U)+(D-r)
                pred |= gv<=tmax
            if axis=='xor' and bh==vb: pred=False
            if pred: out[r][c]=2
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:

def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def flanks(g,r,c):
    bg=g[0][0]; ls=[x for x in range(c-1,-1,-1) if g[r][x]!=bg]; rs=[x for x in range(c+1,len(g[0])) if g[r][x]!=bg]
    us=[y for y in range(r-1,-1,-1) if g[y][c]!=bg]; ds=[y for y in range(r+1,len(g)) if g[y][c]!=bg]
    L=(c-1-max(ls,default=-1)) if ls else 99; R=(min(rs,default=len(g[0])-1)-c) if rs else 99
    U=(r-1-min(us,default=len(g)-1)) if us else 99; D=(min(ds,default=len(g)-1)-r) if ds else 99
    if ls: cL=g[r][max(ls)]; 
    else: cL=None
    if rs: cR=g[r][min(rs)]
    else: cR=None
    if us: cU=g[min(us)][c]
    else: cU=None
    if ds: cD=g[min(ds)][c]
    else: cD=None

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(grid):
    g=grid; h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]; out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bg: continue
            # nearest non-bg left/right in this row
            lo=[cc for cc in range(c) if g[r][cc]!=bg]; hi=[cc for cc in range(c+1,w) if g[r][cc]!=bg]

            ov=(up and dn and not any(g[rr][c]!=bg for rr in range(min(up)+1,max(dn))))
            if ok or ov: out[r][c]=2
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
